name: Lexoraa Industries Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1986, Lexoraa Industries 
Ltd is in the business of manufacturing 
and trading of gems, jewellery and 
bullions, and import and export[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
LIL's business portfolio includes manufacturing, retail, and consulting services, advanced electronic retail solutions, and business consulting. It was engaged in manufacturing, dealing, import and export of industrial products. However, in FY24, after the change in their Management, their business was changed to business of jewellery along with purchasing, selling, and trading in all agricultural and horticultural and agro based products.

pros: Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 68.4 days to 45.6 days
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -3.36%
